notes.title: 4th of july wilson demo update
notes.notes:
wilson demo new update.
The layout has been edited.
Load exit and artbook on the pause button have been activated.
The layout has been reduced.
There is no need to press the button to open the door. It is activated automatically.
Stay tuned for new updates.

notes.title: added english language, new adventure and gamepad
notes.notes:
English language was added to the game. And the adventure of fighting the devil was added. And the gamepad was not working. I solved that problem. I'm sorry if you still encounter some bugs. I hope to make new updates. Either I will develop the Nurtopu 2 ​​game under the name of story mode. Or new adventures with the update to this Nurtopu 1 game. Or I will add a story mode. Feel free to comment. What do you think should be done? Give your ideas.
God bless you.
We die hard.
